ModMetaData.name: Props as Deco - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Props as Deco, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The mod is nothing but xpath patches, so what only a running game can show is whether they apply: a patch whose xpath matches nothing writes a red error per operation. Each pass stages one family of source mods (see the wsl-deps.*.map files) and the scenarios load a save and require a clean log.
